name: Albinauric Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of two Albinaurics.

A strapping duo of cartwheeling spirits who wield ripple swords and spew freezing breath. Both are second-generation Albinaurics, with dumpy heads that resemble those of frogs.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10, requiring a Great Grave Glovewort for the final tier).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two second-generation Albinauric spirits. Each spirit fights wielding a Ripple Blade (ripple sword) in one hand with no shield or armor.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Characterized by erratic, acrobatic movement patterns. They rapidly close distances and dodge incoming attacks by performing dynamic cartwheels and somersault rolls. In melee range, they deliver fluid sword slashes and swipes; at medium range, they regularly pause to unleash a wide, continuous cone of freezing breath.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: The freezing breath inflicts rapid Frostbite buildup, dealing burst damage and reducing enemy damage negation by 20% once triggered. Their rapid succession of blade slashes and continuous frost mist deal steady stance pressure and can reliably stagger or interrupt light humanoid adversaries.

• Synergies & Buffs: Highly effective tactical summon for applying Frostbite and splitting enemy aggro through evasive movement. Both spirits scale effectively with area-of-effect aura buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and sustained regen spells such as Blessing's Boon, compensating for their moderate individual health pools.

name: Ancestral Follower Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of an ancestral follower.

A spirit of the horned folk who eschew letters and metalworking.
Brawny, and versed in distinctive spiritual arts, this particular tribesman wields a heavy bow.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Ancestral Follower spirit. Equipped with a heavy greatbow that shoots magic-infused arrows, a blunt tribal hand-axe for close-quarters fighting, and dressed in horned ancestral regalia.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates primarily as a long-range artillery sniper. At distance, draws and fires heavy arrows with exceptional range and pin-point accuracy, capable of consistently hitting moving targets. When enemies close in, it stows its bow and engages in melee using heavy axe swings. The summon's AI prioritizes holding ground and firing from range unless directly assaulted, after which it stays committed to melee.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals mixed Physical (Pierce/Strike) and Magic damage. Bow shots inflict substantial poise damage and stagger, repeatedly interrupting standard enemies and human-sized targets. Possesses a unique innate passive ability: restores roughly 20% of its maximum HP whenever an enemy is defeated nearby, giving it outstanding longevity against mobs and multi-enemy encounters.

• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits from flat and percentage-based aura buffs such as Golden Vow, Rallying Cry, and Commander's Standard. Thrives when the summoner acts as a frontline tank holding enemy aggro, allowing the follower to freely unleash heavy bow fire. Exceptionally potent in open-field skirmishes, catacombs, and mob-heavy encounters where its on-kill healing sustains its health pool.

name: Archer Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon three archer spirits.

Spirits of archers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City. Their arrows are imbued with cold ghostflame.

Though their methods are somewhat crude, they work well as a squadron, firing a hail of arrows in unison at the sound of a war cry.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10), culminating in a Great Grave Glovewort for the final upgrade tier.

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons three archer spirits of the Fallen Hawks. Each archer is equipped with a bow loaded with ghostflame-infused arrows that deal both physical Pierce and Magic damage. They possess no melee sidearms and fight exclusively from range.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a synchronized ranged firing squad. The trio tends to position at medium-to-long distance, releasing coordinated volleys of arrows rather than staggered individual shots. When enemies close in, they attempt to backstep or reposition to maintain firing lines. Additionally, they possess a unique command mechanic: whenever the player executes the War Cry skill (or compatible roar abilities), all three archers immediately loose a concentrated volley of arrows in unison at the targeted foe.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Arrows inflict cold ghostflame, steadily building up Frostbite with consecutive hits. Upon triggering Frostbite, targets suffer an instant chunk of damage and experience a 20% reduction in overall damage negation for 30 seconds. While single arrows deal modest poise damage, simultaneous three-arrow volleys apply steady stance pressure capable of staggering or interrupting humanoid and lightly armored foes.

• Synergies & Buffs: Functions exceptionally well as ranged fire support when paired with a frontline combatant holding enemy attention. All three archers benefit heavily from area aura buffs such as Golden Vow and Rallying Standard. Using War Cry enables player-directed burst fire on demand, allowing rapid Frostbite application and coordinated stance breaking.

name: Avionette Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of two avionette soldiers.

Spirits of marionette soldiers with avian features that were created to serve a sorcerer. Equipped with long-hafted scythes, they also attack from the skies by lobbing fire pots. Can sometimes malfunction when damaged.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two avionette soldiers. Each puppet possesses mechanical wings, a long-hafted scythe, and fire pots.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Extremely agile combatants that combine aerial mobility with aggressive melee sweeps. They hover and dive from the air with scythe strikes, harass targets from range by lobbing fire pots, and execute rapid sweeping slashes on the ground. When heavily damaged or hit in the head, they trigger a 'malfunction' state marked by sparks and clicking, entering an erratic, high-speed spinning frenzy that unleashes continuous flurries of scythe attacks in all directions.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Scythe strikes inflict passive Blood Loss (Hemorrhage) buildup, which accumulates swiftly during multi-hit combos and the malfunction frenzy. Fire pots deal Fire damage and can briefly interrupt low-poise enemies. While individual stance damage is modest, the sustained volume of strikes rapidly pressures enemy poise.
• Synergies & Buffs: As a multi-entity summon, both puppets benefit significantly from aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard (Rallying Standard). Area-of-effect healing incantations assist in prolonging their survival. Their high mobility and ranged harassment reliably draw enemy aggro, creating tactical openings for players.

name: Banished Knight Oleg
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Oleg, the Banished Knight.

One of the two knights known as the Wings of the Storm.
After his banishment, he attracted the notice of the Grace-Given Lord and later, having slain a hundred traitors as the Lord's hand, Oleg earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.
effect:
Summons the spirit of Banished Knight Oleg.

• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single elite knight clad in full Banished Knight Armor and dual-wielding two Banished Knight's Greatswords.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly aggressive frontline combatant that immediately closes distance on targets. Attacks with rapid, wide-sweeping power-stanced greatsword combos, leaping strikes, and a signature dual-blade storm whirlwind skill that pulls him forward into a spinning vortex of wind and physical slashes. Possesses substantial poise and hyper-armor, allowing him to trade through enemy attacks without flinching.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure standard and pierce physical damage with no innate status buildups. His rapid multi-hit combos and storm attacks inflict heavy poise and stance damage, routinely staggering human-sized foes, knocking enemies down, and opening large bosses to critical ripostes.
• Synergies & Buffs: Excellent frontline distraction and tank for ranged or incantation/sorcery builds. Benefits significantly from allied aura buffs (such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard) as well as continuous area-of-effect health regeneration spells (such as Blessing of the Erdtree).

name: Demi-human Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of five demi-humans.

Spirits of demi-humans that are small in stature, but have a violent, brutish disposition. Though they seem somewhat intelligent, when night falls, their blood boils and they become feral.
effect:
Summons five demi-human spirits.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a pack of five small demi-humans. Individual pack members are equipped with primitive loadouts consisting of wooden clubs, curved falchions, and crude shields.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a relentless swarm unit. They rapidly close distance to surround enemies, executing frantic slashes, club swings, jumping strikes, and vocal shrieks. Possesses a unique night mechanic: when summoned at night, their eyes glow red and their blood boils, entering a feral state that significantly elevates aggression, movement speed, and attack frequency.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals purely physical (Standard, Strike, and Slash) damage with no innate status buildups. The primary utility lies in cumulative stance damage; five summons attacking in rapid succession quickly interrupt animations and stagger humanoid opponents.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly receptive to area-of-effect party buffs (such as Golden Vow, Rallying Standard) and group health regeneration spells (such as Blessing's Boon or Blessing of the Erdtree), as the benefits apply to all five combatants simultaneously. Ideal for overwhelming single targets and dividing boss attention, though susceptible to large sweeping AoE attacks.

name: Fanged Imp Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon two fanged imp spirits.

These spirits are well suited to causing a disturbance, moving nimbly like pests and hurling magic pots.

The two imps seem fond of each other's company.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10)
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two nimble Fanged Imp spirits. Each imp is equipped with a Forked Hatchet and an infinite supply of thrown Magic Pots.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly agile, evasive skirmishers with aggressive close-to-mid range AI. They rapidly dash, sidestep, and leap around targets to disrupt attack trajectories and divide hostile attention. At melee range, they deliver swift, relentless hatchet combos and leaping downward chops; at distance, they periodically disengage to lob Magic Pots that deal ranged magic damage.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Melee attacks with the Forked Hatchet inflict innate Blood Loss (Hemorrhage) buildup. While individual hits deal modest stance damage, their fast attack rate and dual pressure reliably stagger small or unarmored human-sized foes and contribute continuous poise damage.
• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptionally synergistic with Hemorrhage-focused player builds, accelerating blood loss procs on vulnerable enemies. Group aura buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) and passive area-of-effect healing incantations (e.g., Blessing's Boon) substantially offset their relatively low defensive bulk, turning them into persistent distractions and bleed enablers throughout boss encounters.

name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
description:
One of Seluvis's puppets.
Use to summon the spirit of the Finger Maiden Therolina.

Spirit of a Finger Maiden who never met the Tarnished she was meant to guide.
Uses healing incantations and Holy Water Pots, but she is not a fighter by nature and is ill-suited to battle.

A Maiden without a Tarnished. A Tarnished without a Maiden.
And yet no guide to bring them together.
effect:
Summons the puppet spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina.

• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single spirit. Therolina is attired in the Finger Maiden set (Finger Maiden Robe, Finger Maiden Fillet, and Finger Maiden Shoes) and holds a sacred seal to cast Two Fingers incantations, supplemented by an infinite supply of Holy Water Pots.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Passive, pure-support AI. Therolina purposefully stays behind or at mid-to-long distance from enemies and completely lacks melee weapons. She continuously monitors the summoner's HP, casting Great Heal to project an expansive golden healing aura that restores significant health to the player, herself, and allied summons. At range, she supports by lobbing Holy Water Pots at hostiles.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts Holy damage with Holy Water Pots, which permanently eliminates Those Who Live in Death and prevents skeletal resurrection. Casting Great Heal against Royal Revenants deals catastrophic holy damage and severe stance damage, triggering immediate staggers. Against standard adversaries, she provides negligible stance pressure and inflicts no status buildups.
• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptional sustain partner for heavy tank or high-poise builds able to draw and hold boss aggression (e.g., using Shabriri's Woe or the Duelist Set). Benefits from and synergizes with wide-area team buffs such as Golden Vow, Blessing's Boon, and Commander's Standard.

name: Giant Rat Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of three giant rats.

Spirits that do not require FP to summon.
The rat spirits appear at a distance from the summoner, swarming upon their victim to start the fight.

Even as spirits, these vermin seem to multiply endlessly. Enhancing these ashes can increase their numbers.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10). Uniquely requires 0 Runes to upgrade at Roderika, consuming only the respective Glovewort tiers.
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 3 giant rats at base level (+0 to +4), increasing to 4 giant rats at +5 to +9, and reaching a maximum pack size of 5 giant rats at +10. The rats fight unarmed with claws and fangs.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Uniquely materializes at a distance ahead of the summoner rather than directly adjacent, initiating combat immediately with aggressive lunges and bites. They exhibit rapid scurrying mobility and aggressive swarming AI, surrounding targets to divide attention.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts pure physical damage with no innate status effects (no poison, rot, bleed, or madness). Individual attacks deal minor stance damage, but coordinated multi-hit attacks from the pack can repeatedly stagger and stunlock light or human-sized enemies.
• Synergies & Buffs: Costs 0 FP and 0 HP to summon, enabling deployment by any character build regardless of Mind or Vigor investment. Pack size synergizes exceptionally well with flat team-wide aura buffs such as Golden Vow or Rallying Cry, as well as area-of-effect healing incantations.

name: Black Knife Tiche
description:
Legendary ashen remains.
Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche.

Tiche was one of the assassins who, on the night of the plot, imbued her black knife with the Rune of Death and slew Godwyn the Golden.

She was the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader, Alecto, and was killed protecting her mother during their flight from the royal capital.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10, concluding with a Great Ghost Glovewort).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single legendary spirit, Black Knife Tiche. She is outfitted in the complete Black Knife Set and wields the Black Knife, inflicting physical (slash/pierce) and holy damage.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Exhibits unmatched evasion, mobility, and offensive agility. Tiche actively avoids incoming boss strikes and wide-sweeping attacks using continuous sidesteps, somersaults, and backflips. She alternates between rapid close-quarters dagger flurries, diving gap-closers, and her signature unique skill, Blade of Death, which fires a crimson projectile across medium range.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Imbues attacks with Destined Death via Blade of Death and related special maneuvers. This reduces the target's maximum HP by 10% for a limited duration while inflicting continuous health burn scaling directly with the enemy's total HP pool. Her plunging slam attacks inflict high stance damage and can knock down human-sized adversaries.

• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptionally devastating against high-health bosses due to percentage-based maximum HP reduction and sustained DoT. Benefits from player-applied aura and body buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) and passive aura healing effects. Her elusive hit-and-run style naturally draws and juggles enemy aggression, offering sustained openings for the summoner.

name: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a glintstone sorcerer.

Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown.
A scholar of the Olivinus Conspectus, who has mastered the use of the Glintstone Stars sorcery.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Glintstone Sorcerer spirit. The scholar is equipped with an Academy Glintstone Staff, the Olivinus Glintstone Crown, Raya Lucarian robes, and a scholarly tome.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Acts primarily as a ranged spellcaster, maintaining medium distance to cast Glintstone Stars, releasing three homing magic projectiles per cast in repeated volleys. If enemies close into melee distance, the spirit defends itself by swiping with its tome or executing a stone crown headbutt before attempting to reposition. The sorcerer possesses low physical defense and low poise, making it susceptible to being staggered or quickly overwhelmed by aggressive melee foes.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure Magic damage with Glintstone Stars and minor Physical strike damage with melee retaliation. Inflicts no innate status ailments (no Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, or Rot). Possesses minimal stance-breaking capability and zero knockdown or crowd control, though continuous projectile fire helps stall enemy stance recovery.
• Synergies & Buffs: Fully receptive to allied aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow and Rallying Cry, as well as area-of-effect healing spells. Excels as a dedicated backline fire-support unit when the summoner actively engages the enemy in close combat to draw and hold aggro.

name: Godrick Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of two of Godrick's soldiers.

A duo of spirits, consisting of a wielder of devastating charged hammer attacks in the vanguard and a crossbowman bringing up the rear.

The soldiers who serve Godrick the Grafted are what remains of the army that fled the royal capital of the Erdtree.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two Godrick Soldiers clad in standard Godrick Soldier armor (Godrick Soldier Helm, Tree-and-Beast Surcoat, Gauntlets, and Greaves). The vanguard soldier is equipped with a Warpick and a Lordsworn's Shield. The rearguard soldier is armed with a Soldier's Crossbow and carries a Lordsworn's Straight Sword as a backup sidearm.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: The vanguard advances to draw enemy attention, blocking incoming strikes with his shield while executing standard thrusts and heavy charged overhead hammer swings. The rearguard remains at medium-to-long range, steadily reloading and loosing crossbow bolts to pelt foes and interrupt enemy actions, drawing his sword to defend himself if pressured in melee.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure physical damage. The vanguard's charged warpick attacks inflict moderate stance damage, capable of breaking enemy posture and interrupting light humanoid attacks. No innate status effects (such as Hemorrhage, Frostbite, or Poison) are present on either soldier's attacks.

• Synergies & Buffs: Receives full benefits from party-wide aura buffs, attack boosts, and damage reduction incantations (such as Golden Vow and Blessing of the Erdtree). Functionally serves as a balanced frontline-and-support duo capable of dividing enemy attention between ranged harassment and melee defense.

name: Jarwight Puppet
description:
One of Seluvis's puppets.
Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.

Spirit of a man who wished to become the innards of a living jar. A jar-hurling specialist who throws all manner of pots and jars.

The warrior jar once told the nameless man this:
"You are not yet ready to join the warriors inside. No, you must apply yourself! Better yourself, and one day I will return for you."
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Jarwight Puppet spirit. He wears a ceramic Jar helm upon his head paired with simple waistcloth attire, carrying an endless variety of craftable pots with no melee weapons or shields equipped.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Functions strictly as a mid-range consumable skirmisher. Constantly maneuvers around the battlefield to maintain a safe throwing distance, lobbing an endless supply of varied throwing pots at hostile targets. His throwable arsenal includes Fire Pots, Redmane Fire Pots, Volcano Pots, Lightning Pots, Freezing Pots, Swarm Pots, Poison Pots, Fetid Pots, and Oil Pots. When enemies close distance, he attempts to backstep or roll away to create throwing space, resorting to rudimentary bare-fisted punches only if cornered.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Capable of afflicting multiple status conditions across combat encounters. Inflicts Frostbite via Freezing Pots (dealing burst damage, slowing enemy stamina recovery, and amplifying all incoming damage by 20%), Poison/Deadly Poison via Poison and Fetid Pots, and the Oil debuff via Oil Pots (coating enemies to increase subsequent Fire damage received by 50%). While individual pot impacts deal relatively low-to-moderate stance damage, consistent bombardment can stagger lighter enemies and contribute steadily toward posture breaks.
• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptionally synergistic with Fire-based playstyles and Pyromancies, as his frequent Oil Pot throws create prime damage windows for Flame Art armaments and fire incantations. Benefits directly from area aura and body buffs like Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and healing incantations. Operates most effectively alongside frontline combatants or tanky summons who hold enemy aggro, enabling Jarwight to safely pelt foes with continuous elemental and status artillery.

name: Kaiden Sellsword Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a Kaiden sellsword.

Spirit of a mercenary belonging to a horse-riding folk. Skillfully uses a massive blade made for dismounting other riders, and enhances his already considerable strength with war cries.

The sellswords of Kaiden made their prowess known on countless battlefields.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (standard +1 to +9 and Great Grave Glovewort for +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Kaiden Sellsword fighting on foot, equipped with a Dismounter (Curved Greatsword) and wearing the Kaiden Set (Kaiden Helm, Kaiden Armor, Kaiden Gauntlets, and Kaiden Trousers).
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as an aggressive frontline melee combatant. He relentlessly pursues targets with broad sweeping slashes, leaping chops, and running strikes. He periodically casts the War Cry skill, roaring to temporarily boost his physical attack power while altering his heavy attacks into forward-charging slams with elevated hyper armor.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts pure physical damage with no innate status ailment buildup. Produces heavy stance damage and high impact on each blow, consistently interrupting standard enemies, knocking down human-sized foes with charged War Cry attacks, and reliably contributing to boss stance breaks.
• Synergies & Buffs: His innate War Cry buff stacks with player-cast aura buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) and body buffs. Pairs effectively with area-of-effect healing incantations, serving as a durable brawler and frontline disruptor who draws enemy aggression away from the summoner.

name: Greatshield Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon five greatshield soldier spirits.

Spirits of greatshield soldiers who belonged to the Fallen Hawks, a band of soldiers that once explored the Eternal City.

Stout defenders with a steady guard. Though their methods are somewhat crude, they work well as a squadron, and will attract the attention of enemies or lob ghostflame from the rearguard.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a phalanx of five Fallen Hawk greatshield soldiers. Each soldier is equipped with an Inverted Hawk Towershield and an unlimited supply of throwable ghostflame pots.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Fights in a close-knit squadron formation, advancing toward targets to surround and corner them. Frontline soldiers keep their shields raised to absorb blows, frequently delivering Shield Bashes that deal Strike damage. They actively pull enemy attention by beating their shields and shouting war cries. Soldiers positioned in the rearguard or at mid-range lob ghostflame pots at enemies.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Shield bashes inflict physical Strike damage and significant stance damage, capable of interrupting attacks and staggering opponents. Ghostflame pots deal Magic damage and build up Frostbite; when triggered, Frostbite removes an immediate percentage of the target's maximum health and lowers damage absorption by 20% for 30 seconds. While frontal defenses are exceptionally durable against physical strikes, soldiers remain susceptible to overhead swings, sweeping flank attacks, and area-of-effect ground hazards.

• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits immensely from area-wide aura buffs (such as Golden Vow or Commander's Standard) and passive healing over time incantations (such as Blessing of the Erdtree), as their high natural damage negation maximizes the effective durability gained per point of health restored. Functions as a premier tanking and agro-drawing summon, neutralizing mobile or single-target adversaries while giving the player ample room to cast spells or execute charged attacks.

name: Lhutel The Headless
description:
Legendary ashen remains.
Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.

Spirit of a headless knight who leads the mausoleum soldiers. Wields a lance enrobed in Death and hurls spectral lances at foes.

Lhutel sacrificed her life so that in Death she could continue to protect a soulless demigod until their revival, earning her the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.
effect:
Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

Summon Composition & Equipment:
• Summons the spirit of Lhutel the Headless, a legendary headless Mausoleum Knight.
• Equipment: Equipped with the headless Mausoleum Knight armor set, a Lance enrobed in Death, and the Eclipse Crest Greatshield.

Combat Behavior & Skills:
• Hybrid Combatant: Seamlessly transitions between close-quarters melee thrusts and long-range pressure.
• Phasing & Teleportation: Periodically dematerializes and teleports across the arena. This grants high survivability against boss combos and area-of-effect attacks, though dropping threat can cause enemies to temporarily redirect aggro toward the summoner.
• Spectral Lance: Hurled ethereal lances target enemies at medium to long range, drawing attention and maintaining engagement.
• Shield Defense: Uses the Eclipse Crest Greatshield to block attacks and absorb heavy physical strikes while safely retaliating with lance thrusts.

Status Effects & Stance Damage:
• Death Blight: Melee lance strikes inflict Death Blight buildup. (Note that virtually all standard PvE enemies and bosses are immune to Death Blight; effect is primarily applicable against humanoid Tarnished opponents).
• Stance Damage: Spectral Lance throws inflict high stance damage, capable of breaking enemy poise and triggering critical stuns when striking head weak points.

Synergies & Buffs:
• Fully receptive to aura and body buffs such as Golden Vow, Flame, Grant Me Strength, and Commander's Standard.
• Synergizes well with heal-over-time incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree), enabling her already formidable survivability to sustain throughout protracted encounters.
• Optimal partner for spellcasters, archers, and fragile melee builds that benefit from an elusive, self-preserving tank.

name: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of a mad pumpkin head.

Spirit of a mad soldier with a large, brawny physique. Though he has stifled his panic within the dark confines of his helmet, he rampages as if driven mad when agitated by bloodshed or the humming of insects. This mad soldier is all that is left of a broken gladiator.
effect:
Summons the spirit of a Mad Pumpkin Head.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgrades from +1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Calls forth a single Mad Pumpkin Head spirit. He wears a massive Pumpkin Helm and gladiator garb, wielding a Chainlink Flail in his main hand.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as an aggressive frontline melee tank with immense poise and hyperarmor. Attacks with sweeping flail strikes, overhead crushing smashes, and running charges. Strikes that contact his Pumpkin Helm suffer roughly 80% damage reduction and deflect lighter physical attacks. When Blood Loss triggers nearby (or when exposed to insectile humming), he enters an agitated frenzy, violently slamming his armored head into the ground repeatedly in a devastating area-of-effect tantrum.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Flail strikes deal heavy Strike damage and inflict innate Hemorrhage (Blood Loss) buildup. His weapon swings and heavy head slams deal tremendous stance damage, reliably knocking down humanoid adversaries and breaking the posture of large bosses.
• Synergies & Buffs: Pairs exceptionally well with player Bleed setups, which actively trigger his frenzy state. He receives full benefits from aura, body, and defensive buffs (such as Golden Vow or Blessing's Boon), serving as a durable, disruptive damage sponge and posture-breaking vanguard.

name: Marionette Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of two marionette soldiers.

Spirits of marionette soldiers created to serve a sorcerer. These marionettes are archers, each equipped with a pair of bows.

On the verge of falling apart, they are ill-disciplined and attack without warning.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two Marionette Soldier archers. Each four-armed automaton is outfitted with a pair of short bows, allowing them to fire dual volleys of standard piercing arrows in rapid succession.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates primarily as stationary, long-to-medium-range artillery. Rather than engaging in direct melee skirmishes, both puppets anchor their positions and barrage hostile targets with relentless streams of arrows. When struck repeatedly or suffering heavy damage, their internal mechanisms malfunction, triggering an erratic frenzy where they spin 360 degrees while firing arrows wildly in all directions. This spinning barrage deals devastating multi-hit damage at point-blank range or against large-bodied adversaries, though accuracy drops sharply at distance against standard-sized targets.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Arrows deal pure physical piercing damage without innate status effects. However, the immense volume and speed of their projectile volleys exert relentless stance pressure, routinely stagger-locking unarmored or low-poise foes and preventing boss stance recovery timers from initiating.

• Synergies & Buffs: Highly synergistic with flat attack power increases such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as the flat damage bonus is applied across every individual arrow in their sustained barrages. Serves as premier sustained ranged fire support, continuously distracting bosses and suppressing aggressive enemies from safe distances.

name: Lone Wolf Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of three lone wolves.

Spirits of wolves chased from their pack. They later encountered a nameless Tarnished, who welcomed them as hunting companions.

The wolf spirits overwhelm enemies with their agility, aiding the summoner in combat.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10), classifying them as a standard Spirit Ash.

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons three agile wolf spirits simultaneously. The wolves fight without manufactured weapons or armor, utilizing natural bite attacks, claw swipes, and lunging bites to deliver standard physical slash damage.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a fast, aggressive pack. The wolves circle and flank enemies from multiple directions, using rapid hit-and-run tactics, lunging pounces, and multi-hit bite sequences. Their high mobility and constant movement allow them to continuously trade aggro and interrupt lighter foes, though they can be vulnerable to wide, heavy area-of-effect sweeps.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Pure physical damage with no innate status effect buildup (such as Bleed, Frostbite, or Poison). Despite having no heavy single-hit stance damage, their relentless attack frequency applies constant poise pressure, preventing enemy poise regeneration and routinely staggering humanoid enemies.

• Synergies & Buffs: Highly responsive to AoE aura buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and group healing incantations (e.g., Blessing's Boon, Erdtree Heal). Their pack distribution makes them superb for distracting single-target bosses and creating safe casting or heavy attack windows for the summoner.

name: Mimic Tear Ashes
description:
Legendary ashen remains.

Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear.
Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

This spirit takes the form of the summoner to fight alongside them, but its mimicry does not extend to imitating the summoner's will.

Mimic tears are the result of an attempt by the Eternal City to forge a lord.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10, concluding with a Great Ghost Glovewort).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single duplicate spirit that copies the summoner's active loadout at the moment of summoning, including armor, right- and left-hand weapons, shields, talismans, memorized spells, and items equipped in the quick-item bar or pouch. The spirit possesses unlimited FP to cast spells and execute weapon skills, as well as an infinite supply of ammunition and equipped consumable items (such as throwing pots, perfumes, and Raw Meat Dumplings) without consuming the player's stock. It cannot use Flasks of Crimson or Cerulean Tears.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates with aggressive, adaptable combat AI capable of utilizing light, heavy, jumping, and dual-wielding (power-stance) attacks, executing equipped Ashes of War, blocking with shields, and casting equipped sorceries or incantations. Movement includes dodging, sprinting, and closing distance. While it acts independently rather than following direct player commands, its tactical versatility scales directly with the breadth and setup of the copied loadout.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Replicates all damage types, auxiliary status buildups (such as Bleed, Frostbite, Scarlet Rot, Poison, Sleep, and Destined Death), and stance damage inherent to the player's weapons and skills. Coordinated attacks alongside the player accelerate status procs and rapidly deplete enemy poise, yielding frequent stance breaks and knockdowns against formidable foes.

• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits from all standard allied aura and area buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, Flame, Grant Me Strength) and can cast equipped buff incantations autonomously. Can be sustained via area-of-effect healing incantations, Warming Stones, or self-administered Raw Meat Dumplings. If summoned while wearing aggro-generating equipment such as Shabriri's Woe, it permanently retains heightened enemy hostility for the duration of the encounter, functioning as an elite frontline tank.

name: Nightmaiden & Swordtress Puppets
description:
An old puppet crafted in the Eternal City.

Use to summon the spirits of a nightmaiden and a swordstress.

These sisters, members of a cold-blooded race who wield flowing weapons, became puppets of their own volition.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two distinct humanoid spirits—a Nightmaiden and a Nox Swordstress. The Nox Swordstress is armed with the Nox Flowing Sword, which extends into a whip-like liquid blade during heavy slashes. The Nightmaiden wields a Nox flowing armament and silver dagger, alongside area-denial mist abilities. Both wear the traditional silken robes and ceremonial crowns of the Nox civilization.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a coordinated dual-unit combat team where each sister possesses an individual health bar. Both entities exhibit exceptional mobility, frequently utilizing rapid evasive backsteps, ducking maneuvers, and sidesteps to evade incoming heavy attacks. The Swordstress relentlessly pressures enemies at close-to-medium range with wide fluid slashes, while the Nightmaiden alternates between rapid melee strikes and flowing sweeps, effectively juggling enemy aggro back and forth between them.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts pure physical damage without innate status effects (such as Hemorrhage or Frostbite). However, their fluid metal weapon strikes deal reliable stance damage and consistent flinch/stagger on standard humanoid adversaries, while wide sweeping arcs provide superior crowd control against multi-target encounters.
• Synergies & Buffs: Both sisters receive full individual benefits from area-of-effect buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) as well as regenerative or burst healing incantations. Their dual-entity presence and evasive AI make them one of the most effective tag-team spirit summons for splitting boss attention and sustaining sustained pressure.

name: Noble Sorcerer Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a noble sorcerer.

Spirit of a nobleman who once asked to be given a place at Raya Lucaria to learn glintstone sorceries. His talents were insufficient to be worthy of donning the stone crown, however, and he is only capable of using the most rudimentary sorcery.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 Noble Sorcerer spirit. Wears standard nobleman's garb and wields a glintstone staff; carries no shield or protective armor.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Acts as a rudimentary ranged spellcaster. At mid-range, he fires slow-paced Glintstone Pebble projectiles that deal Magic damage. If cornered in close melee quarters, he resorts to feeble physical staff thumps. When confronted by intimidating foes or massive creatures (such as dragons), his AI exhibits cowardly behavior, frequently cowering, recoiling, or fleeing instead of casting.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure Magic damage with Glintstone Pebble and negligible Strike/Physical damage with staff swings. Inflicts zero status effect buildup (no Hemorrhage, Frostbite, Poison, Scarlet Rot, or Destined Death). Possesses negligible stance damage and cannot stagger or knock down resilient enemies.
• Synergies & Buffs: Requires an exceptionally low cost of 11 FP, making him immediately summonable by every starting class without Mind investment. Can be enhanced with aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow or Commander's Standard, as well as allied healing incantations. Best deployed as a minimal-investment decoy or early-game ranged distraction.

name: Nomad Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a nomad.

A member of a tribe that was entombed in the earth so as to bury the maddening disease that followed them.
Able to emit the terrible flame of frenzy from his eyes, but has low HP and is frail, unable to take much in the way of punishment.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Nomad spirit. The nomad is clothed in tattered nomadic merchant garments and wields no conventional armaments or shields, relying entirely on channeling frenzied flame.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Functions as a mid-range incantation turret. Upon engaging an opponent, the spirit grasps its head in anguish and projects the Flame of Frenzy incantation from its eyes, discharging erratic, high-damage bursts of frenzy flame in an outward conical spread. It possesses minimal poise, frail defenses, and very low HP, making it susceptible to being rapidly interrupted or felled by aggressive melee attackers.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals substantial Fire damage and accumulates Madness status buildup. While the Madness ailment primarily afflicts Tarnished-model targets and invading NPC humanoids, the multiple fiery projectiles deal solid base fire damage, modest stance impact, and light crowd-control hit-stun across a wide area.
• Synergies & Buffs: Functions best when the player commands enemy aggression, enabling the Nomad to cast its long-animation Frenzied Flame unhindered. Damage output benefits from aura and damage enhancers including Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Flame-Shrouding effects, while continuous regeneration incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree) help mitigate its extremely low survivability.

name: Omenkiller Rollo
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Omenkiller Rollo.

Spirit of Rollo, known as the first Omenkiller.
Once a famous perfumer, Rollo imbibed a physick to rid himself of emotion, thus enabling him to enact his nightmarish labor, hunting the Omen.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
- Summons 1 elite spirit: Omenkiller Rollo.
- Equipment: Dual Great Omenkiller Cleavers, Omensmirk Mask, Omenkiller Robe, and Omenkiller Boots/Gloves.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
- AI Behavior: Rollo is a relentlessly aggressive frontline bruiser who sprints headlong into combat, closing gaps quickly and constantly drawing enemy attention.
- Melee Combos: Executes sweeping dual-cleaver combos, alternating slashing strikes, and multi-hit flurry attacks.
- Leaping Slam: Performed at mid-range, Rollo leaps into the air and crashes both cleavers downward in rapid succession, closing distance and flattening or interrupting smaller adversaries.
- Fire Breath: Spits a wide, channeled arc of blazing fire from his mouth that blankets the terrain in front of him, dealing fire damage and leaving burning patches that damage enemies passing through.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
- Hemorrhage (Bleed): Every strike with his Great Omenkiller Cleavers accumulates passive blood loss buildup, reliably triggering Hemorrhage against vulnerable foes during sustained attack strings.
- Fire Damage & Frost Reset: Fire breath deals pure fire damage. This fire damage immediately removes the Frostbite state from frozen enemies, allowing players using Cold builds to re-apply Frostbite repeatedly for consecutive percentage health damage bursts.
- Stance Damage: The dual heavy cleaver strikes and plunging leap attacks inflict substantial stance and poise damage, capable of breaking the guard of shielded opponents and opening bosses to critical strikes.

• Synergies & Buffs:
- Tactical Role: Offensive frontline juggernaut, burst damager, and aggro magnet.
- Aura & Body Buffs: Scales effectively with universal physical and fire offensive enhancements such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Flame, Grant Me Strength (which boosts both his physical cleaver hits and his fire breath).
- Build Synergies: Excels alongside bleed/arcane builds (synergizing with Lord of Blood's Exultation) as well as frost-infliction strategies exploiting his fire breath to reset the frost debuff.

name: Raya Lucaria Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of three Raya Lucaria soldiers.

A trio of spirits, consisting of two disposable foot soldiers and their superior.

The soldiers of Raya Lucaria were also known as the "Cuckoos." They were given free rein by the academy to wage war as they pleased, and they were infamous for their rapacious ways.
effect:
Summons three Raya Lucaria soldier spirits: two foot soldiers and one superior soldier.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Consists of a three-man squad of Cuckoo combatants. The two disposable foot soldiers wield straight swords and shields, wearing light foot soldier attire. Their commanding superior is outfitted in Raya Lucaria armor with a Cuckoo helm, wielding a straight sword, shield, and consumable Cuckoo Glintstones.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as an aggressive mixed melee-and-ranged unit. The two foot soldiers rush into close quarters to distract, surround, and pressure targets with rapid sword strikes. The superior soldier engages in coordinated melee strikes, guards with their shield, and periodically tosses Cuckoo Glintstones that fire homing magical projectiles dealing magic damage.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals standard physical, slash, pierce, and magic damage. Inflicts no innate status effects, but the combined pressure of three combatants provides consistent stance damage, light flinching, and enemy stagger against humanoid and unarmored targets.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly receptive to area-of-effect buffs such as Golden Vow, Flame, Grant Me Strength, and Commander's Standard, as well as group heal-over-time incantations. Serves as an effective early-to-mid game distraction squad capable of drawing aggro away from spellcasters and ranged combatants.

name: Page Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a page.

Spirit of a page who traveled at the side of the noble he served. Uses a piercing sword and crossbow to defend his master.

One becomes a page merely by accident of being born into obscurity; nothing is asked of ability, talent, or volition.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Page spirit armed with a piercing sword (thrusting sword), a crossbow loaded with explosive bolts dealing physical and fire damage, and the complete Page Set (Page Hood, Page Garb, Page Trousers).
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a hybrid skirmisher, favoring medium-range engagements where he consistently fires explosive bolts that burst on impact. When opponents enter melee range, he defends himself with rapid thrusting attacks and pokes before evasively dodging backward to resume ranged suppression.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals physical (pierce) and fire damage with zero innate status buildup. Explosive bolts deliver solid impact stagger that can interrupt humanoid and low-poise foes, though overall stance damage against heavy bosses is minimal.
• Synergies & Buffs: Synergizes best with frontline melee combatants capable of drawing enemy aggression, granting the Page uninterrupted firing windows. Receptive to group buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as well as area-of-effect healing incantations to bolster his light armor durability.

name: Skeletal Militiaman Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of two skeletal militiamen.

These are the spirits of militiamen who live in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off.

This is the grotesque fate of those who come into contact with Deathroot.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort up to +10.
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two Skeletal Militiamen. Each militiaman is equipped with a short spear and a round medium shield.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Engages in melee combat using forward spear thrusts, multi-hit stabbing combos, and lunging gap-closers while intermittently blocking incoming light attacks behind their shields. Features the innate resurrection trait of Those Who Live in Death: when their HP is fully depleted, they collapse into glowing skeletal remains on the ground; after several seconds, they reassemble and revive with partial HP. This cycle repeats indefinitely unless they are struck while collapsed in their downed state.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals standard and pierce physical damage with no innate status buildup (no Bleed, Frost, Poison, or Rot). Stance damage is modest per hit, but continuous paired thrusts can interrupt light humanoid adversaries.
• Synergies & Buffs: Excellent frontline distraction against single-target bosses without wide ground-sweeping attacks or persistent AoE hazards. Fully receptive to aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow, Rallying Standard, and health regeneration incantations.

name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon a spirit jellyfish.

A floating spirit that illuminates its surroundings. Prone to tears, the jellyfish girl searches for her distant home.
Will bravely spew poison at foes on her summoner's behalf.
It seems her name is Aurelia.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Spirit Jellyfish spirit named Aurelia. Possesses no weapons or shields, but emits a soft luminous aura that illuminates dark environments.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a durable, long-range distraction and support summon. Aurelia drifts slowly through the air and fires slow-moving, arcing streams of acidic fluid at targets from a distance. If enemies close in, she occasionally uses a close-range tentacle bump. While her attacks are slow and easily interrupted by aggressive melee foes, her exceptionally high base health pool allows her to absorb significant damage and hold enemy aggression.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Her ranged spit inflicts heavy Poison buildup, reliably afflicting susceptible bosses and regular enemies with the Poison status effect. Possesses minimal poise damage and stance-breaking capability.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly effective when paired with aggressive players or glass-cannon caster builds that benefit from an enemy being distracted. Greatly augmented by area-of-effect defensive buffs (e.g., Golden Vow) and passive regeneration spells (e.g., Blessing's Boon), further increasing her durability. Additionally, summoning Aurelia near her sister at Stargazers' Ruins resolves an environmental puzzle.

name: Skeletal Bandit Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a skeletal bandit.

This is the spirit of a bandit who lives in Death, and will continue to rise again until properly finished off.

After the night of the plot, Deathroot appeared in the Lands Between, and Those Who Live in Death soon followed.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgrades up to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
  - Summons a single Skeletal Bandit spirit.
  - Wields dual curved swords (Bandit's Curved Swords) and wears ragged cloth armor. Carries no shield or ranged equipment.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
  - Agile and offensive melee skirmisher that actively seeks close-quarters combat.
  - Moves rapidly to attack targets with quick multi-hit dual-wielding curved sword combinations, running slashes, and leaping strikes.
  - Resurrection Mechanic: As one of Those Who Live in Death, it does not permanently die upon depleting its health. Instead, it collapses into an illuminated pile of skeletal remains. If it is not hit while down, it will reconstruct itself after several seconds with replenished health and resume fighting indefinitely. Sustaining any attack, wide area damage, or lingering hazard while collapsed will permanently destroy it.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
  - Delivers pure physical (Standard/Slash) damage with no innate status buildup.
  - High hit frequency easily staggers unarmored or light enemies, but the summon possesses low poise and negligible stance-breaking capability against large or heavily armored targets.

• Synergies & Tactical Role:
  - Exceptionally economical summon with an FP cost of 22, usable by any starting class without Mind investment.
  - Serves as an enduring, recurring distraction against bosses and elite enemies that lack widespread area-of-effect or lingering surface attacks. When downed, enemy aggro naturally shifts back to the player, allowing the bandit to revive and reclaim attention.
  - Benefits from external aura and party-wide buffs such as Golden Vow and Rallying Cry to augment damage output and survivability.

name: Stormhawk Deenh
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of Deenh the Stormhawk.

Spirit of a fierce hawk that faithfully rendered lifelong service to the old king of Stormveil long ago, when the true storm raged. Its cries embolden its fellows in battle, and the tempestuous winds that encircle it shred through foes.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (upgrades to +10 as a renowned spirit ash).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single spirit, Deenh the Stormhawk. Unlike standard Warhawks encountered in Stormveil, Deenh wields no blade attachments, fighting entirely with natural talons, beak, and wind-harnessing storm abilities.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Deenh is an agile aerial skirmisher that remains airborne during combat. Deenh frequently circles targets before diving with rapid claw swipes, beak pecks, and a multi-hit spiraling wind-drill charge. Being permanently airborne grants Deenh natural evasion against ground-level sweeps, shockwaves, earthquakes, and hazard surfaces (lava, poison, or rot). Periodically, Deenh releases an empowering war cry that applies an Aura buff lasting 60 seconds to the summoner and all nearby allies, providing +20% Physical Damage, +20% Stamina Damage, and +20% Stance Damage.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure standard physical damage with wind properties and inflicts no status buildups. Deenh's corkscrew dive delivers high poise damage capable of staggering and knocking down human-sized foes. Furthermore, Deenh's war cry amplifies the player's stance damage by 20%, greatly speeding up boss posture breaks and critical ripostes.

• Synergies & Buffs: Deenh's war cry is classified as an Aura Buff; it will overwrite or be overwritten by other aura buffs such as Golden Vow or Commander's Standard / Rallying Standard. However, it stacks multiplicatively with Body buffs (such as Flame, Grant Me Strength or Boiled Crab), weapon enhancements (Greases, Royal Knight's Resolve), and talisman effects. Deenh serves as an exceptional offensive support summon that harasses enemies and draws aggro while significantly boosting the damage and stance-breaking capabilities of melee builds, colossal weapon users, and physical spellcasters.

name: Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a Twinsage sorcerer.

Spirit of a Raya Lucaria sorcerer wearing a stone crown.

Those who study the Twinsage Conspectus are the academy's elite, capable of mastering the Glintstone Cometshard and Crystal Burst sorceries.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort [1] - [10].

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Twinsage Sorcerer spirit. The sorcerer is equipped with an Academy Glintstone Staff in the main hand, a heavy academic tome in the off-hand, and wears Raya Lucarian Sorcerer Robes topped with the iconic Twinsage Glintstone Crown.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates primarily as a ranged magical artillery summon. From medium to long range, the sorcerer casts Glintstone Cometshard, hurling piercing comets of glintstone magic for significant burst damage, as well as Crystal Burst, releasing a scattered shotgun-like spray of crystal fragments effective against wide targets or clustered foes. When pressed in close quarters, the sorcerer defends itself by swinging its tome or executing a blunt headbutt using its heavy stone crown before retreating to range. The spirit has low physical defense and low poise, making it vulnerable to interrupts and knockdown if targeted.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts pure Magic damage with sorceries and Physical strike damage with melee crown and book attacks. Does not apply any status buildups (no Bleed, Frost, Rot, or Poison). Deals moderate stance damage via repeated projectile impacts from Glintstone Cometshard and multi-pellet hits from Crystal Burst.

• Synergies & Buffs: Highly synergistic with frontline melee playstyles that draw and maintain enemy aggression, allowing the sorcerer to cast continuously undisturbed. Directly benefits from aura and group buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as well as wide-area health restoration incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree, Erdtree Heal) to mitigate its fragile health pool.

name: Wandering Noble Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of five wandering nobles.

The spirits of nobles who, after death, now wander the Lands Between. Surely they were in search of something once—but whatever it was has long been forgotten.
effect:
Summons five spirits of wandering nobles.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgrades from +1 to +10, concluding with a Great Grave Glovewort).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons five Wandering Nobles dressed in tattered noble clothing with negligible defensive ratings. Three nobles are armed with standard straight swords for basic slashing melee attacks, and two carry torches that deal minor fire damage and physical blunt strikes.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Characters exhibit slow, shambling movement speeds and telegraphed melee attack animations. AI aggression is passive-to-moderate; nobles will slowly close distance with enemies to swing their weapons. Against intimidating or colossal enemies such as dragons and massive beasts, the nobles often become terrified and cower, failing to attack. Their primary utility is dividing enemy attention across multiple bodies.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure physical and minor fire damage with no innate status effects (no Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). Inflicts minimal stance damage per hit, though five simultaneous attackers can interrupt and stagger low-poise humanoid targets. Possesses virtually zero poise and low health, leaving them extremely susceptible to knockdowns and sweeping area-of-effect attacks.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly receptive to area-wide buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and regenerative incantations (Blessing's Boon, Blessing of the Erdtree). Due to their high count and low durability, their sequential deaths can be exploited with on-kill restoration effects (such as the Serpent-God's Curved Sword or Taker's Cameo). Functions as an inexpensive, early-game diversionary decoy summon.

name: Rotten Stray Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a rotten stray.

Spirit of a stray dog corrupted by the scarlet rot.
Though it is only a small creature, it is as violent as it is nimble, and its fangs fester with poisonous rot.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Rotten Stray. The creature fights unarmed, relying entirely on its rot-corrupted fangs and claws; it carries no shields or equipment.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly agile, aggressive melee combatant. It darts rapidly toward targets, executes quick lunges and biting attacks, and circles around adversaries. However, it possesses very low overall health and poise, leaving it vulnerable to being staggered and killed by wide area-of-effect strikes.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts Scarlet Rot buildup with every successful bite attack. Rapidly applies Scarlet Rot to vulnerable enemies and bosses, dealing percentage-based damage over time. Delivers minimal stance damage and low stagger capability.
• Synergies & Buffs: Requires only 35 FP to summon, allowing any starting class to cast it without additional Mind investment. Greatly benefits from aura buffs such as Golden Vow or Commander's Standard, as well as gradual healing incantations (like Blessing's Boon) to sustain its low health pool until Scarlet Rot procs. Functions primarily as an early-to-mid-game status affliction specialist.

name: Warhawk Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of a warhawk.

Spirit of a Stormveil warhawk, the talons of which have been sliced off so that razor-fine swords could be grafted in their place.
With its lord vanquished, and its wings wounded, the hawk perished as it solemnly gazed at its former home.

The storm is a warhawk's cradle.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Stormveil Warhawk equipped with razor-fine swords grafted to its sliced-off talons.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates entirely as a high-mobility aerial combatant. It circles targets from the air before executing swooping dive-bomb slashes with its bladed talons, beak pecks, and close-to-mid range fire breath spray attacks. Its constant flight elevation allows it to naturally evade ground-level sweeps, earthquake effects, and low-hitting melee attacks, although it can be vulnerable to vertical anti-air swings, ranged spells, and broad area-of-effect blasts.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Standard, Slash, and Fire damage. Inflicts no passive status buildups. Deals light stance damage against heavy foes, but reliably interrupts and staggers unarmored or humanoid enemies with its erratic attack flurries.
• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits from aura and damage buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Flame, Grant Me Strength. Excels as an evasive harasser and target distraction, keeping enemy aggression divided while evading ground-based hazard zones.

name: Latenna The Albinauric
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of Latenna the Albinauric.

A rare case of one who chose to become a spirit voluntarily.
Latenna was renowned as a deft magic archer. But having lost her beloved wolf companion, Lobo, she cannot move from the place where she was summoned.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
  - Summons 1 spirit: Latenna the Albinauric, clad in the Blue Silver Mail set and wielding an Albinauric bow.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
  - Stationary Artillery: Latenna is completely stationary and cannot walk or reposition from the spot where she is summoned. However, her engagement distance is among the longest of any summon, allowing her to target enemies from immense distances, across large boss arenas, or from elevated cliffs and ledges.
  - Burst Archery: Fires rapid three-arrow volleys of glowing magical projectiles that deal Magic damage and possess tracking capabilities.
  - Direwolf Mounting Mechanic: When summoned near a hostile Direwolf, Latenna can pacify and mount the creature, granting her complete mobility and enabling a cold breath attack.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
  - Standard arrow volleys deal Magic and Pierce damage without innate status buildup. Can inflict Frostbite via frost breath when mounted on a Direwolf.
  - Low individual stance damage per projectile, but her continuous high-tempo volley cadence effectively halts enemy stance recovery over time.

• Synergies & Buffs:
  - Functions as a dedicated backline sniper while the Tarnished holds enemy aggression and keeps foes within her line of fire.
  - Receives benefits from aura buffs (e.g., Golden Vow, Rallying Standard) cast prior to engagement, as well as enemy magic defense shred (e.g., Ranni's Dark Moon).

name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of a winged misbegotten.

A spirit with the aspect of wings which takes flight to loose arrows from its bow.
The misbegotten are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and from birth they are treated as slaves, or worse.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 Winged Misbegotten spirit equipped with a shortbow and a backup dagger.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Airborne ranged harasser. Immediately takes flight upon being summoned and hovers above the battlefield, firing a steady volley of arrows from mid-range. Its aerial positioning allows it to naturally evade low-profile ground sweeps, ground hazards, and melee attacks. However, it possesses low poise and modest health, meaning ranged attacks or vertical strikes will readily knock it out of the air. If forced into close combat or cornered on the ground, it will defend itself with rapid dagger slashes before attempting to regain distance.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure physical damage. Does not inflict any innate status buildup (no Bleed, Frost, Rot, or Poison). Deals low stance damage per shot, but continuous ranged harassment helps stall enemy stance recovery timers.
• Synergies & Buffs: Most effective when paired with a frontline combatant or tanky setup that holds enemy attention, allowing the spirit to provide uninterrupted aerial fire support. Benefits from group aura buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as well as area regeneration or healing incantations.

name: Bloodhound Knight Floh
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Floh, the Bloodhound Knight.

Spirit of a Bloodhound Knight they called the Rabid Stray.
Will attack without pause immediately after being summoned.

Floh vowed that there was only one lord he would ever serve: a true king. And so, the Rabid Stray never found a master.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 spirit—Floh, the Bloodhound Knight (known as the "Rabid Stray"). Wields the Bloodhound's Fang curved greatsword alongside offhand Bloodhound Claws, outfitted in the full Bloodhound Knight Set.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Hyper-aggressive melee fighter that charges into battle without pause immediately upon summoning. Moves in a low-profile, hunched quadrupedal stance that can slip beneath high horizontal sweeps, utilizing rapid Bloodhound's Step dashes and evasive somersaults to weave in and out of enemy range. Executes sweeping cleaves, low-lunging slashes, leaping strikes, and evasive retreat maneuvers akin to Bloodhound's Finesse.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Physical (Slash/Standard) damage and inflicts innate Hemorrhage (Blood Loss) buildup on weapon hits. Sustained multi-hit attack strings build rapid stance damage and readily interrupt or stagger humanoid opponents, though Floh possesses modest poise and can be staggered by heavy hyper-armor blows.
• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptional synergy with Bleed and multi-hit combat builds, stacking blood loss buildup alongside the summoner. Benefits greatly from area aura and health-regeneration buffs (such as Golden Vow or Blessing of the Erdtree) to sustain uninterrupted melee pressure and hold boss aggro.

name: Perfumer Tricia
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Tricia, the perfumer.

Tricia was once known as a healer who dedicated her efforts to treating Misbegotten, Omen, and all those seen as impure. When her efforts failed, she was their companion as they died, watching over them to ensure that they could pass peacefully, free of pain. A tale akin to the origins of the deathbed companions.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons the spirit of Perfumer Tricia. She is equipped with the Perfumer Set, a Perfumer's Shield, and perfume bottles used to disperse aromatic compounds.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Serves as a defensive and supportive companion rather than a frontline melee fighter. Upon summoning and periodically throughout engagement, she casts Uplifting Aromatic, enveloping the summoner and herself in a golden protective aura. At close to medium ranges, she scatters Spark Aromatic powders that erupt into delayed arcs of explosive fire damage to repel advancing enemies. When attacked directly, she raises her shield to block incoming strikes while attempting to retreat to safer casting range.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals fire damage through Spark Aromatic, inflicting minor stance pressure and light hitstun capable of interrupting low-poise foes. She does not inflict status effects such as Bleed, Frost, or Poison.
• Synergies & Buffs: Exceptional support summon for offensive melee players and spellcasters alike. Her Uplifting Aromatic provides a +10% physical damage boost for 60 seconds and a damage-negation shield that reduces incoming damage from the next hit by up to 90%, allowing safe aggressive exchanges. Tricia continuously reapplies this buff across extended battles and synergizes with allied aura buffs like Golden Vow or direct restorative healing spells.

name: Leyndell Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of two Leyndell soldiers.

Spirits of soldiers each equipped with a spear and greatshield.
The soldiers of Leyndell fight their battles defensively. During the Shattering, they were the ramparts that fortified the royal capital.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgraded from +1 to +10 using Grave Glovewort [1]-[9] and Great Grave Glovewort).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
  - Summons two Leyndell Soldiers.
  - Equipment: Each soldier is equipped with an infantry spear and a heavy greatshield, wearing the Leyndell Soldier Set (Leyndell Soldier Helm, Tree-and-Beast Surcoat, Leyndell Soldier Gauntlets, and Leyndell Soldier Greaves).

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
  - Combat Style: Employs a disciplined, highly defensive phalanx doctrine. Both soldiers keep their greatshields raised, turtling against enemy strikes while executing guarded pokes from safety.
  - Moveset: Features single and multi-thrust spear attacks (Pierce damage), guarded thrusts from behind raised shields, and heavy shield bashes/slams (Strike damage) when enemies close distance.
  - AI & Survivability: Passive and deliberate in positioning. They maintain a solid defensive frontline with high guard boost and physical negation, effectively absorbing hostile pressure, though they do not aggressively hunt enemies down.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
  - Status Buildup: None. They deal pure physical (Pierce and Strike) damage.
  - Stance & Crowd Control: Shield bashes can interrupt and stagger standard humanoid enemies. While they steadily chip away at enemy stance through synchronized thrusts, their defensive tempo generally results in low burst stance break potential against high-poise bosses.

• Synergies & Buffs:
  - Area Buffs: Excellent recipients of area-of-effect buffs like Golden Vow and Commander's Standard (Rallying Cry), maximizing their defensive mitigation and offensive output.
  - Healing & Regeneration: Regenerative incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree, Blessing's Boon) amplify their natural durability behind greatshields, allowing them to anchor the battlefield for extended durations.
  - Tactical Role: Serves as a durable, FP-efficient (64 FP) dual-tank summon that holds chokepoints and absorbs physical aggression, affording ranged spellcasters, archers, and flanking melee fighters ample breathing room.

name: Miranda Sprout Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of five miranda sprouts.
Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

Spirits of sweet little miranda flowers, carnivorous blossoms that feed upon human flesh. They creep slowly, scattering toxic pollen. Vulnerable to fire — do take care of the little darlings.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (Grave Glovewort [1] to [9] and Great Grave Glovewort for +10). Upgrades scale the spirits' maximum HP, physical damage, and defenses.

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons five (5) Miranda Sprouts simultaneously. The sprouts possess no manufactured weaponry, armor, or shields, relying entirely on their biological forms.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Miranda Sprouts exhibit extremely slow mobility, creeping sluggishly toward hostile targets. They function primarily as stationary or semi-stationary area-denial turrets. At close range, they execute body slams and headbutts against adjacent foes. At medium range, they scatter dense clouds of toxic pollen spores across the battlefield. Note that they possess an extreme vulnerability to Fire damage, suffering severe damage and hitstun when burned.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: The pollen clouds inflict rapid, cumulative Poison status buildup. With five individual sprouts blanketing an area, targets lingering inside the overlapping clouds are quickly poisoned. Physical bashes inflict minimal stance damage and lack poise-breaking capability, but the cluster of five bodies provides physical collision that can body-block standard enemies and divert enemy attention.

• Synergies & Buffs: Utilizing an HP cost (185 HP) rather than FP allows builds with minimum Mind/FP investment to summon them freely without expending Cerulean Flasks. The reliable poison application immediately activates damage-boosting gear including Kindred of Rot's Exultation and the Mushroom Crown. Area-of-effect buffs (such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) and group regeneration spells (such as Blessing of the Erdtree) bolster their survivability and battlefield persistence.

name: Vulgar Militia Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of three vulgar militiamen.

Spirits of the vulgar militia who wield long-hafted, serrated hatchets. These brutal weapons are particularly effective at causing blood loss to opponents.

In the Lands Between, the small were scorned, and so they formed their vulgar militia as a means to make a living, albeit in ignominy.
effect:
Summons three Vulgar Militiaman spirits.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgrades from +1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons three agile vulgar militiamen wearing tattered militia attire and wielding long-hafted, serrated Vulgar Militia Saws. They also carry disorienting smoke bombs.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly mobile, erratic guerrilla fighters with an aggressive swarm AI. Their diminutive stature allows them to naturally slip beneath many high-reaching enemy swings and sweeping projectiles. They execute acrobatic leaps, low spinning sweeps, sprinting lunges, and jumping chops. They occasionally deploy smoke screens to obscure vision and disrupt enemy targeting.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: All three spirits inflict innate Hemorrhage (Blood Loss) buildup on weapon hits. Because three combatants attack in rapid succession, they trigger blood loss swiftly against vulnerable foes. Their rapid strikes consistently stagger and interrupt small- to medium-sized enemies, although individual stance damage against colossal bosses is modest.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly synergistic with Bleed-focused player setups to rapidly overwhelm bleed resistances. Group-wide buffs such as Golden Vow, Rallying Standard, and lingering health-regeneration incantations dramatically enhance their damage output and help offset their modest individual health pools.

name: Land Squirt Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirits of three land squirts.

Summoning consumes HP rather than FP. These spirits appear some distance from the summoner.

The firm, fleshy tubes of the creatures remain rooted to the spot, spraying poisonous liquid over their surroundings.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons three Land Squirts. They possess no weapons, shields, or armor, consisting entirely of firm, tubular, fleshy bodies rooted to the ground.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Completely immobile upon manifestation, appearing a set distance ahead of the summoner. Incapable of chasing, dodging, or repositioning, they act as stationary biological turrets that periodically compress and spray wide plumes of poisonous fluid over their immediate vicinity. Though easily staggered due to low poise, they possess substantial health pools that allow them to endure direct enemy aggression while the summoner kites enemies through their perimeter.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Rapidly inflicts Poison buildup on any target entering their toxic mist. Deals negligible direct physical and stance damage. Features a volatile status interaction: if inflicted with Poison or Scarlet Rot, Land Squirts will bloat and trigger a violent self-destructive explosion dealing heavy physical and poison damage, which also deals collateral status buildup to the summoner if standing within range.

• Synergies & Buffs: Consumes 240 HP instead of FP, making them accessible to builds with minimal Mind investment. Directly activates damage multipliers from Kindred of Rot's Exultation and the Mushroom Crown upon successful poison infliction. Benefits from persistent area-of-effect healing incantations (such as Blessing's Boon or Blessing of the Erdtree) and defensive auras (such as Golden Vow), serving as an effective area-denial and hazard-control summoning option.

name: Kindred Of Rot Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon a spirit of the Kindred of Rot.

This spirit takes the form of a crawling pest, its chitinous body making a dry rustling sound. Attacks enemies by secreting sticky threads.

The Kindred of Rot are the servants of the Goddess of Rot—servants that have been forsaken.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
