• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Kindred of Rot (pest spirit) armed with a Pest's Glaive. The spirit relies on its natural chitinous carapace for defense, granting innate non-physical damage negation without wearing armor or wielding a shield.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as a hybrid ranged-skirmisher. At medium-to-long range, it unleashes volleys of homing sticky threads (Pest Threads) that curve through the air to strike targets. When forced into melee, it executes sweeping halberd slashes, overhead chops, and rapid multi-limbed thrusts using its glaive. Its AI utilizes skittering, evasive repositioning to create distance for further projectile barrages.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Thread projectiles and physical strikes contribute to Scarlet Rot buildup. Features an innate exultation mechanic that increases its attack power by 20% for 20 seconds whenever Poison or Scarlet Rot is triggered nearby. Multi-hit thread streams exert continuous poise pressure, efficiently interrupting smaller enemies and steadily wearing down the stance of massive targets.

• Synergies & Buffs: Excels as anti-large artillery against colossal foes and dragons whose large hitboxes absorb every tick of Pest Threads. Strongly synergizes with player builds inflicting Poison or Scarlet Rot to keep its damage buff continuously active. Can be augmented with team-wide aura buffs like Golden Vow or Commander's Standard, as well as area healing incantations.

name: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes
description:
Legendary ashen remains.
Use to summon the spirit of Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight.

Spirit of Kristoff, an honorable knight of Leyndell who was also a devout worshipper of the ancient dragons. His skills strike down foes with thunderbolts, the dragons' weapon of choice.

After the First Defense of Leyndell, Kristoff earned the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial for the feat of capturing Godefroy the Grafted.
effect:
Summons the legendary spirit of Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight.

• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Ghost Glovewort up to +10.
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single elite knight clad in full Leyndell Knight Armor, wielding a Partisan spear and a Golden Greatshield. Imbued with Ancient Dragon Cult arts.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Functions as an elite defensive tank and mid-range disruptor. In close quarters, Kristoff actively raises his greatshield to absorb incoming physical and elemental blows, executes guarded thrusts (shield pokes), thrust combinations, and punishing guard counters. At medium-to-long range, he channels Ancient Dragon lightning through his spear, calling down pinpoint thunderbolts and lightning strikes directly onto targets to maintain pressure and aggro.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Standard/Pierce physical damage complemented by Lightning damage. Inflicts no innate status ailments (Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). Boasts high stance-breaking capability through persistent guard counters and heavy thrusting attacks, frequently staggering humanoid opponents and exposing larger bosses to critical hits. Ranged lightning strikes can interrupt spellcasting and ground flying adversaries.
• Synergies & Buffs: Outstanding frontline anchor for spellcasters, archers, and squishier melee builds requiring durable aggro management. Fully receptive to aura and body buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and defensive incantations. Due to his high base defenses and active guarding with a greatshield, heal-over-time incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree) and burst area heals drastically multiply his functional durability throughout protracted boss battles.

name: Azula Beastman Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of two Azula beastmen.

Spirits of beastmen from doomed Farum Azula, the slowly crumbling ruins in the skies. These ruins are said to be the remains of a giant mausoleum enshrining an ancient dragon, guarded by chosen beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (strengthened up to +10 using Grave Glovewort [1] through [9] and a Great Grave Glovewort).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two Azula Beastmen spirits into combat. Both beastmen wield massive Beastman's Cleavers (curved greatswords) permanently imbued with lightning elemental damage. Neither spirit carries shields or secondary ranged weapons, dedicating themselves entirely to sweeping melee attacks.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Features hyper-aggressive, rush-down behavior. The beastmen rapidly charge hostiles, initiating combat with leaping downward strikes and wide horizontal slashes. Once in range, they maintain relentless pressure via continuous multi-hit cleaver flurries, jumping attacks, and wild sweeping combos dealing both heavy physical and lightning damage.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts no auxiliary status buildup (no Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). However, their heavy curved greatswords inflict substantial stance and poise damage, frequently flinching standard enemies, interrupting attack animations, and setting up poise breaks on bosses when attacking in unison.

• Synergies & Buffs: High-tempo offensive pressure duo well suited for staggering agile enemies and distracting bosses. Because they lack defensive equipment and possess moderate defensive durability, they benefit greatly from offensive and defensive aura buffs (such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard) as well as continuous health regeneration incantations (e.g., Blessing's Boon, Erdtree Heal). Their lightning damage naturally scales against enemies in rain or wet environments.

name: Banished Knight Engvall Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of Engvall, the Banished Knight.

One of the two knights dubbed the Wings of the Storm. Despite his banishment, he rejected the invitation of the Grace-Given Lord, instead keeping watch over a masterless castle for many years, gaining renown as a hero of the fringes.
effect:
Summons the spirit of Banished Knight Engvall.

• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 spirit—Banished Knight Engvall. He is equipped with the Banished Knight Set (with hooded helm) and wields a Banished Knight's Halberd two-handed.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Engvall functions as a tenacious frontline melee combatant. He utilizes the halberd's reach for sweeping horizontal chops, lunging thrusts, and overhead strikes. He frequently incorporates wind-based martial skills: Stormcaller, unleashing a multi-hit vortex of wind around himself that shreds nearby foes, and Storm Assault, leaping into the air enshrouded in tempestuous winds before plunging down with a devastating thrust. He exhibits high poise and hyper armor during his heavier swings and skill animations, allowing him to trade hits without interruption.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Standard and Pierce physical damage. Causes no innate status effect buildup (no Bleed, Frost, Rot, or Poison). Excels at posture pressure and crowd control; his storm skills and heavy halberd slams deliver massive stance damage, frequently staggering or knocking down humanoid and mid-sized enemies while contributing heavily to stance-breaking large bosses.
• Synergies & Buffs: Acts as a formidable vanguard tank and crowd controller. Highly complementary to ranged and spellcasting builds by drawing aggressive enemy focus. Benefits significantly from aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow or Rallying Standard, as well as gradual health regeneration incantations (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree), maximizing his staying power in prolonged battles.

name: Battlemage Hugues Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of Battlemage Hugues.

Hugues came from Sellia to study the Haima Conspectus at the academy, where he became a battlemage. Haima scholars seek to quell conflict with cannon fire and the gavel, but Hugues developed a longing for it.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons the spirit of Battlemage Hugues, a solitary elite battlemage of Sellia. He is equipped with the Battlemage Set (Haima Glintstone Crown, Battlemage Robe, Battlemage Manchettes, and Battlemage Legwraps). In battle, he wields a Glintstone Staff alongside a Stone Club, allowing him to cycle seamlessly between Sorceries of Haima and heavy physical strikes.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Hugues acts as a hybrid artillery caster and frontline brawler. At long to medium range, he pressures targets using Great Glintstone Shard and unleashes Cannon of Haima, firing an explosive projectile that detonates in a large area-of-effect blast. In close quarters, he aggressively engages rather than backing away, smashing enemies with his Stone Club or casting Gavel of Haima to summon and slam a massive magical warhammer with immense hyper armor.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Magic and Strike physical damage with no innate status effects (Bleed, Frost, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). In exchange, he possesses outstanding crowd-control and stance-breaking capabilities. Cannon of Haima knocks down and scatters light and standard enemies over an area, while Gavel of Haima inflicts heavy stance damage capable of interrupting enemy animations, pancaking foes, and opening bosses to critical strikes.

• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits from aura and health buffs including Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and regenerative healing incantations (e.g., Blessing's Boon, Erdtree Heal). Magic-boosting debuffs such as Ranni's Dark Moon amplify his magical bombardment. Tactically, Hugues serves as a durable all-rounder capable of artillery support against clustered mobs and resolute frontline disruption against high-poise single targets.

name: Blackflame Monk Amon Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Amon, the Blackflame Monk.

Amon swore fealty to the god-slaying black flame, and so became the first fire monk to turn traitor. Or perhaps it is better said that he fled from the Giants' Flame—out of cowardice.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
  - Summons 1 spirit: Amon, the Blackflame Monk.
  - Equipment: Wears the Blackflame Monk Set (Hood, Armor, Gauntlets, Greaves) and wields a Monk's Flamemace in hand, casting Godslayer incantations.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
  - Acts as a hybrid melee and mid-range combatant, rotating between physical blunt strikes and god-slaying black flame sorceries/incantations.
  - Melee Attacks: Performs deliberate mace swings, sweeps, and overhead slams dealing physical Strike damage.
  - Incantations: Fires concentrated Black Flame fireballs at ranged targets and unleashes Scouring Black Flame in a sweeping horizontal wave across a broad frontal arc.
  - Gains significant hyperarmor during his spellcasting animations, allowing him to endure light-to-medium incoming hits without being interrupted.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
  - Applies the signature god-slaying Black Flame burn on all flame attacks, draining a percentage of the enemy's maximum HP as damage-over-time over roughly two seconds. This percentage-based drain is particularly devastating against late-game bosses with vast health pools.
  - Mace impacts deal solid stance damage, regularly flinching humanoid adversaries and contributing to poise breaks on heavier targets.

• Synergies & Buffs:
  - Receptive to player-applied aura and body buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Flame, Grant Me Strength, which elevate both his physical blunt impact and fire damage.
  - Benefits greatly from allied AoE healing spells (e.g., Erdtree Heal, Blessing's Boon) to sustain his health pool during extended hyperarmor trades.
  - Serves as an offensive damage-over-time boss killer, functioning at peak efficiency when players split aggro so Amon can chain-cast black flame incantations safely.

name: Clayman Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of two claymen.

Bowed with age, these spirits are sluggish but hard to stagger. The warped remains of priests who searched for revelation in service of the ancient dynasty, they employ two sorceries that produce smaller and larger bubbles.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons two ancient Clayman priest spirits. Unarmed with physical weaponry, each priest utilizes innate catalytic channeling gestures to cast bubble-based ancient dynasty sorceries.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Functions as ranged spellcaster spirits characterized by very slow, lumbering movement but exceptional poise and hyper-armor that prevents them from being easily staggered or interrupted while casting. They employ two distinct sorceries:
  - Oracle Bubbles: Blows a cluster of small, floating bubbles that drift toward targets before detonating upon contact or lingering briefly as proximity mines.
  - Great Oracular Bubble: Conjures a large, slow-drifting bubble that causes a high-damage magic explosion across an area of effect upon impact.
Defensively, their petrified clay bodies have high natural damage negation against Slash, Pierce, Standard physical damage, and Lightning, but remain vulnerable to Strike damage.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure Magic damage; does not inflict any status ailments (Bleed, Frost, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). Inherent immunities include total resistance to Poison, Scarlet Rot, Madness, and Death Blight. Great Oracular Bubble delivers moderate stance damage and blast impact capable of staggering humanoid enemies, while the rapid successive pops of Oracle Bubbles interrupt lighter foes.

• Synergies & Buffs: Magic damage output benefits significantly from aura and area buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Terra Magica. Their immense poise and status immunities make them durable stationary artillery against bosses lacking Strike attacks, maintaining steady ranged aggro while the summoner flanks or casts from afar.

name: Crystalian Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of a Crystalian.

Spirit that wields round crystalline blades, both big and small. Its sturdy body, itself hewn from crystal long ago, is hard enough to blunt its opponent's blades, but blows from bludgeoning weapons can shatter it easily.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded with Grave Glovewort up to +10.

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Crystalian spirit wielding dual circular crystalline blades (one large ringblade held in the primary hand and one smaller ringblade in the off-hand). Possesses no armor or shield, utilizing its natural crystalline body for defense.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Moves with deliberate, rhythmic hopping and walking steps to close the distance. In melee combat, it executes sweeping horizontal cuts, hopping slices, and spinning multi-hit ringblade combos. At medium range, it hurls the smaller ringblade forward as a returning projectile disc to harass targets before re-engaging in melee. Maintains persistent, unyielding aggro on its target.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals pure physical damage and applies no status effects. Features a unique crystal shell defense mechanic: prior to having its stance broken, it possesses extreme damage negation (~90% against slashing, piercing, and standard physical strikes, as well as high elemental negation) and immense hyperarmor that prevents flinching from regular attacks. Weak to Strike (bludgeoning) damage, which rapidly depletes its posture. Once stance-broken, its crystalline shell permanently fractures, stripping its high damage negation and leaving it vulnerable to normal damage and stagger. Completely immune to Hemorrhage (Bleed), Frostbite, Sleep, and Madness, with near-total resistance to Poison and Scarlet Rot.

• Synergies & Buffs: Functions as a premier defensive vanguard against enemies dealing slash or pierce damage and status ailments. Highly receptive to aura and body buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard. Healing over time incantations (such as Blessing's Boon or Bestial Vitality) and direct healing spells provide massive effective health value while its crystalline shell remains unbroken.

name: Depraved Perfumer Carmaan Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of Carmaan, the depraved perfumer.

Depraved perfumers practice their art for themselves alone.
Carmaan was a notably formidable perfumer whose strength rivaled that of heroes, and it is said that he was in search of a secret physick of revivification.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 spirit, Carmaan the depraved perfumer. Wears the Depraved Perfumer Set and wields an Erdsteel Dagger alongside specialized perfume bottles loaded with Spark Aromatic and Poison Spraymist. Carries personal healing draughts.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates primarily as an aggressive mid-range skirmisher and crowd controller. Scatters Spark Aromatic in wide forward arcs to ignite violent explosive bursts of Fire damage, and casts Poison Spraymist to saturate combat zones in lingering toxins. When enemies close in, he utilizes evasive backward rolls and rapid dagger strikes. Carmaan possesses autonomous self-healing, actively retreating when low on health to drink from a healing flask to restore a substantial amount of HP, granting exceptional battlefield longevity.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Continuously builds up Poison on targets within his mist clouds. Spark Aromatic deals significant Fire damage and moderate stance break potential capable of staggering light-to-medium enemies and disrupting charge attacks.
• Synergies & Buffs: Benefits from aura and body buffs such as Golden Vow, Flame, Grant Me Strength, and Commander's Standard. Pairs exceptionally well with poison-centric builds and equipment (such as Kindred of Rot's Exultation or the Mushroom Crown), as his consistent poison application reliably triggers bonus damage modifiers.

name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay Ashes
description:
Legendary ashen remains.

Use to summon the spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay.

Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable feat of dedication, carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree, fending off countless foes along the way. She was one of the celebrated few who fought alongside Malenia, though her life came to an end soon after fulfilling her duty.
effect:
Summons the legendary spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay.

• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Cleanrot Knight hero equipped with the complete Cleanrot armor set, wielding a Halo Scythe in her right hand and a Cleanrot Knight's Sword in her left hand.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Finlay is an aggressive and highly versatile combatant capable of seamless transitions between ranged, melee, and support roles. In melee range, she executes swift thrusts and slashing combinations with her sword and scythe. At medium to long range, she repeatedly casts the weapon skill Miquella's Ring of Light, unleashing sacred golden projectile rings that deal holy damage. Additionally, she unleashes a virulent scarlet rot breath spray that blankets the area ahead of her.
• Support & Buffs: Upon engaging in combat, Finlay casts an area-of-effect golden incantation buff that grants continuous HP regeneration over time and boosts physical attack power and defenses for both herself and the summoner.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts rapid Scarlet Rot buildup through her rot breath incantation, dealing heavy damage over time to non-immune targets. Her attacks deal a combination of physical, slash, pierce, and holy damage, while her steady melee thrusts and projectile rings deliver consistent stance damage to break enemy guards and posture.
• Tactical Synergies: Synergizes exceptionally well with offensive builds, particularly poison and rot builds utilizing talismans such as the Kindred of Rot's Exultation. Her combined self-sustain, ranged projectile pressure, and front-line engagement make her one of the most reliable and enduring legendary spirit summons.

name: Dung Eater Puppet
description:
One of Seluvis's puppets.
Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater.

Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses.

The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end.
How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single spirit, the Dung Eater Puppet. He is equipped with the full Omen Set (Omen Helm, Omen Armor, Omen Gauntlets, and Omen Greaves) and wields the Sword of Milos. He also utilizes an Omen Bairn to unleash cursed wraiths.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: A relentless, ultra-durable front-line brawler. Dung Eater Puppet aggressively closes distance using heavy, sweeping strikes. He regularly unleashes the weapon skill Shriek of Milos, emitting a roar that reduces all enemy damage negations by 5% and lowers status ailment resistances within range for 40 seconds. When Shriek of Milos is active, his heavy attack chains become rapid multi-hit combos. If he uses Shriek of Milos while the roar buff is already active, he triggers an explosive shockwave that launches homing spectral wraiths. At medium-to-long ranges, he employs the Omen Bairn to cast tracking golden wraith projectiles.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: The Sword of Milos inflicts innate Blood Loss buildup with each physical blow, regularly triggering Hemorrhage. His heavy swings and enhanced combo attacks deal immense stance damage, frequently staggering foes and opening bosses for critical strikes. Due to his heavy Omen armor and high poise, he possesses formidable hyper-armor and rarely flinches from enemy attacks.

• Synergies & Buffs: Acts as a premier tank and aggressive boss debuffer. The damage negation and status resistance penalties applied by Shriek of Milos stack multiplicatively with player-cast aura and body buffs like Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, significantly accelerating Hemorrhage and Frostbite triggers. His massive health pool and high native defense make him exceptionally effective when supported by sustained healing incantations.

name: Fire Monk Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirit of a Fire Monk.

Spirit of a stout monk who monitored the Giants' Flame. Versed in fire incantations, and himself steeled against fire.

Though he was charged with keeping watch over the Flame, after many years of solemn duty, he has succumbed to its allure.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single Fire Monk spirit. He is equipped with the full Fire Monk Set (Fire Monk Hood, Fire Monk Armor, Fire Monk Gauntlets, Fire Monk Greaves) and wields a Monk's Flamemace, casting fire incantations from the offhand.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates as an aggressive frontline melee combatant supported by close-range pyromancy. He engages targets directly with one-handed mace swings, blunt strikes, and running attacks. At close quarters, he seamlessly weaves fast-acting fire incantations—notably Catch Flame—to unleash sudden bursts of flame damage. He possesses extraordinarily high innate fire damage negation, making him exceptionally resilient against fire-based adversaries.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals a combination of Physical (Strike) and Fire damage. Inflicts no inherent status ailments (such as Hemorrhage, Poison, or Rot), but his heavy mace blows yield solid stance and poise damage, capable of staggering standard enemies and crushing strike-weak opponents such as Crystallians and stone miners. His fire attacks immediately reset the Frostbite status on inflicted targets and trigger panic/burning animations on flammable foes like Fingercreepers and Miranda Flowers.
• Synergies & Buffs: Synergizes exceptionally well with offensive buffs such as Flame, Grant Me Strength (which simultaneously enhances both his Physical Strike and Fire damage outputs), Golden Vow, and Commander's Standard. Regenerative incantations like Blessing's Boon or Erdtree Heal bolster his frontline longevity. He is also a premier partner for Frostbite builds that utilize rapid status reset loops.

name: Dolores The Sleeping Arrow Puppet
description:
One of Seluvis's favorite puppets.

Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow.

Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man.
Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow.

Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single puppet spirit, Dolores the Sleeping Arrow. She is equipped with a Shortbow loaded with St. Trina's Arrows, and wears Page Garb, Page Trousers, and an Aristocrat Headband.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Acts as a dedicated ranged skirmisher who avoids melee combat. She maintains medium-to-long distance from targets, utilizing backward evasive rolls and hops when enemies approach. Her primary attack is a continuous, rhythmic volley of sleep-inducing arrows fired from her shortbow.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts rapid Sleep buildup on every landed shot. Highly effective against susceptible enemies and bosses (such as Godskin Noble and Godskin Apostle, Runebears, and Giants), rendering them unconscious. Deals low direct stance damage, but the induced sleep status allows for uncontested critical hits and fully charged attacks.
• Synergies & Buffs: Outstanding utility in encounters with multiple difficult foes, allowing the player to incapacitate one target while focusing on another. Synergizes exceptionally well with burst damage weapons, Colossal Weapons, and sleep-oriented gear. Receives benefits from aura buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as well as AoE healing spells.

name: Haligtree Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of four Haligtree soldiers.

Spirits of common soldiers who carry the sacred light. When weakened, they explode to deliver a last-ditch attack.

This was the bitter revelation discovered by the desperate soldiers who awaited the return of their lord to the rotted Haligtree.
May the flash of our deaths guide Miquella's return.
effect:
Summons four Haligtree soldier spirits.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (upgraded from +1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons four Haligtree foot soldiers outfitted in Haligtree Crest Surcoats and foot soldier attire. Two soldiers wield short swords dealing Standard physical damage, and two wield daggers. All four soldiers carry consumable Poison Pots.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly aggressive foot soldiers that rush targets. At initial engagement range, all four throw a volley of Poison Pots to initiate status buildup before closing in for rapid melee slashes and stabs. Once an individual soldier's health falls below approximately 50%, they prime a suicidal detonation of sacred light, sacrificing themselves to cause an immediate, high-damage Holy explosion in their vicinity.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Ranged pot attacks rapidly build up Poison on target enemies. Melee swings deal light physical and stance damage, while the suicide Holy explosion inflicts severe stance damage, capable of interrupting large enemies and knocking down human-sized foes.
• Synergies & Buffs: Area-of-effect buffs (such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard) increase both standard physical strikes and the burst damage of the Holy self-destruct blast. They excel as aggressive swarm infantry and living area-of-effect cluster bombs against enemy packs.

name: Man-serpent Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirit of a man-serpent.

Spirit of a deformed man-serpent that wields a whip of magma.
It is said that long ago, the elder serpent that dwelled on Mt. Gelmir devoured a demigod, and the birth of the man-serpents followed.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10, requiring a Great Grave Glovewort for +10). As a standard spirit ash, it does not utilize Ghost Glovewort.
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons 1 Man-Serpent spirit. It wields a Magma Whip Candlestick in its right hand and carries no shield, relying on its natural reptilian hide for defense.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Operates effectively at mid-to-close range, utilizing wide sweeping lashes, overhead strikes, and lunging whip attacks. Its swings fling molten lava across the ground, creating residual magma pools that inflict continuous Fire damage over time to enemies standing within them. The spirit exhibits moderate aggression, adjusting distance to take advantage of the whip's extended reach.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals split Physical (Strike) and Fire damage with no inherent status effect buildup (such as Bleed, Frostbite, or Poison). Individual whip strikes deal moderate-to-low stance damage, but the lingering magma pools reliably stagger and interrupt unpoised, lightweight enemies caught in the area of effect.
• Synergies & Buffs: Highly receptive to Fire-damage boosting effects like Flame, Grant Me Strength (which buffs both its physical and fire damage) as well as Oil Pots thrown by the player. It also benefits from aura buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard (Rallying Standard), while healing-over-time spells (e.g., Blessing of the Erdtree) help sustain its mid-tier defensive durability.

name: Mausoleum Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of five mausoleum soldiers.

Spirits of five headless soldiers who confound foes by disappearing and reappearing at will.
The mausoleum is where the bodies of soulless demigods are lain to rest, and these soldiers followed their masters into Death by severing their own heads from their bodies.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Upgraded using Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons five headless Mausoleum Soldiers wearing Mausoleum Surcoats, gauntlets, and greaves. The squad comprises two soldiers armed with Greatswords, two equipped with Warpicks and shields, and one wielding a Straight Sword.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Fully melee-focused combatants that exhibit relentless group aggression. Their defining tactical ability is an innate short-range teleportation mechanic; soldiers frequently phase out and reappear beside or behind hostile targets. This allows them to instantly close gaps, disrupt enemy attack tracking, flank shields, and evade incoming blows. They swarm targets continuously, combining sweeping greatsword swings with rapid pick and sword strikes.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Delivers standard and pierce physical damage without innate status effects (no Bleed, Frost, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). Despite lacking status buildup, the collective impact of five coordinated melee attackers generates high stance damage and continuous poise interruption. They easily stunlock regular and humanoid enemies and can induce stance breaks on larger bosses under sustained focus.

• Synergies & Buffs: Summons five separate combatants, providing unmatched scaling with wide-area aura buffs like Golden Vow, Commander's Standard (Rallying Cry), and Shared Order. AoE regeneration and healing incantations (e.g., Blessing's Boon, Lord's Heal) dramatically boost their group durability, compensating for individual squishiness against large wide-sweeping boss attacks. Tactically serves as one of the best distraction and aggro-scrambling swarms available.

name: Oracle Envoy Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of four Oracle Envoys.

Spirits of a monstrous band of musicians who employ sacred arts.

It is said that when Oracle Envoys appear, playing their pipes, they do so to herald the arrival of a new god, or age.
effect:
Summons four Oracle Envoy spirits.

• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Calls forth four small Oracle Envoys clad in white wraps. Each envoy wields an Envoy's Horn (a golden curved pipe) used both as a sacred instrument and as a blunt striking weapon.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: The four envoys act primarily as ranged artillery. From distance, they play their pipes to cast Oracular Bubble, launching slow-moving, gently homing golden spheres that detonate on impact for Holy damage. They waddle slowly across the arena to maintain positioning and stagger their shots, creating a continuous bubble barrage. If enemies close the distance, they perform clumsy melee swings with their horns or execute low-damage physical headbutts and body presses before attempting to retreat and resume blowing bubbles.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals Physical (Strike) damage in melee and Holy damage with projectiles. Inflicts no innate status ailments (no Bleed, Frost, Rot, or Poison). While a single bubble applies minimal impact, coordinated continuous volleys across four summons can interrupt regular enemy attacks and rapidly chip away at large hitboxes, building meaningful cumulative stance damage against large bosses.
• Synergies & Buffs: Especially lethal against Deathbirds, Death Rite Birds, and Those Who Live in Death due to high Holy damage volume and resurrection prevention. The quad-summon formation benefits immensely from wide aura buffs such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and continuous healing incantations like Blessing of the Erdtree, sustaining their barrage and dividing boss attention.

name: Putrid Corpse Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of four putrid corpses.

These spirits appear some distance from the summoner. Though their movements are dull and confused, their low moans make them effective at drawing the attention of enemies.

True death does not come easily for them.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
  - Summons four Putrid Corpse spirits simultaneously.
  - Equipment: Unarmed and unarmored, wearing only shredded rags. Offense consists entirely of bare-handed flails, clawing swipes, and bites.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
  - Spatial Positioning: Materializes at a distance from the summoner rather than directly adjacent to them.
  - Aggro Generation: Continuously emits low, droning moans that possess innate aggro-drawing priority, consistently diverting enemy and boss focus away from the summoner.
  - Movement & Aggression: Shambles with a slow, clumsy, and erratic gait. AI tracking is confused and plodding, focusing exclusively on close-quarters melee combat.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
  - Status Buildups: Physical attacks apply minor Poison buildup on targets.
  - Stance & CC: Possesses low individual poise and negligible stance damage, making them susceptible to knockdowns and staggers. However, the presence of four bodies creates physical obstructions and repeated target switches for single-target opponents.

• Synergies & Buffs:
  - Tactical Role: Extremely cost-effective (40 FP) meat shield and aggro-diverting decoy, ideal for ranged sorcery, archery, and incantation users needing space to cast.
  - Synergies: Synergizes exceptionally well with group buffs (Golden Vow, Commander's Standard) and passive area healing incantations (Blessing's Boon, Erdtree Heal) to bolster their collective survivability.
  - Vulnerabilities: Weak to wide sweeping cleaves, piercing thrusts, and area-of-effect fire damage, which can eliminate multiple corpses at once.

name: Radahn Soldier Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.

Use to summon the spirits of two of Radahn's soldiers.

Both spirits wield fiery weapons to perform powerful skills. Such is their valor that they will immediately attack after being summoned.

General Radahn's soldiers were all reputed to be masterful warriors, and it was popularly said that the Redmanes knew no weakness.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (+1 to +10).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
Summons two Redmane Soldiers sworn to General Radahn. Both combatants are outfitted in the Radahn Soldier armor set (including the Redmane Surcoat). One soldier wields a Lordsworn's Greatsword and carries Fire Pots. The second soldier wields a Lordsworn's Straight Sword, a medium shield, an off-hand Torch, and Fire Pots.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
Exhibits immediate hyper-aggression upon summoning, instantly charging into combat without delay. In melee range, the greatsword soldier executes wide horizontal swings, vertical slashes, and lunges with high poise damage. The sword-and-shield soldier pairs rapid slashes and defensive blocks with torch sweeps and torch fire bursts. At medium ranges, both soldiers frequently throw Fire Pots to deal burst fire damage and harass targets.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
Inflicts Standard physical, Pierce, and Fire damage. Causes no inherent status effect buildup (such as Bleed or Scarlet Rot), but fire damage reliably causes panic and stagger in beasts, Fingercreepers, and plant-based enemies, while resetting Frostbite for repeated frost procs. The Lordsworn's Greatsword attacks inflict considerable stance damage, routinely interrupting enemy attack chains and staggering standard foes.

• Synergies & Buffs:
Pairs effectively with player-thrown Oil Pots to amplify fire damage from their weapons, torches, and fire pots. Fully benefits from aura and group buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, as well as area-of-effect healing over time incantations. Functions as a durable, aggressive dual-unit strike team ideal for drawing enemy attention and maintaining constant offensive pressure.

name: Redmane Knight Ogha
description:
Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Ogha, the Redmane Knight.

Spirit of a mighty knight versed in the use of a greatbow. A valiant warrior who will attack immediately after being summoned.

The longest-serving member of the Redmane Knights, Ogha studied techniques to manipulate gravity alongside Radahn.
May use a rain of gravitational arrows in response to a war cry, but only once.
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (upgraded from +1 to +10 using Ghost Gloveworts and a Great Ghost Glovewort).

• Summon Composition & Equipment:
- Summons the spirit of Redmane Knight Ogha (single spirit summon).
- Armor: Full Redmane Knight Set (Redmane Knight Helm, Redmane Knight Armor, Redmane Knight Gauntlets, Redmane Knight Greaves).
- Armament: Greatbow firing gravity-infused greatarrows, Knight's Greatsword, and Redmane Greatshield.

• Combat Behavior & Skills:
- Immediate Engagement: Attacks instantly upon summoning, immediately locking onto and engaging hostile targets.
- Ranged Bombardment: Operates primarily as heavy artillery at medium-to-long range, loosing powerful gravity-imbued greatarrows that stagger and pierce targets.
- Roar Interaction (Rain of Gravitational Arrows): If the summoner executes a roar skill (such as War Cry, Barbaric Roar, Braggart's Roar, Beast's Roar, Troll's Roar, or Shriek of Milos), Ogha responds with a roar of his own, gains a temporary attack power boost, and unleashes a devastating rain of gravitational arrows modeled after Radahn's signature technique. This gravitational volley can only be triggered once per summon, though the damage buff can be reapplied on subsequent roars after it expires.
- Close Quarters Combat: If enemies close the distance, Ogha stows his greatbow and draws his Knight's Greatsword and Redmane Greatshield. In melee, he blocks incoming attacks, performs guard counters, and executes the Lion's Claw Ash of War—a front-flipping overhead slam with high hyper-armor.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage:
- High Stance Break & Knockdown: His gravitational greatbow shots deal massive stance and poise damage, consistently knocking down human-sized adversaries and staggering larger enemies.
- Melee Impact: Lion's Claw deals substantial stance damage, rapidly breaking enemy guards and opening bosses to critical strikes.
- Damage Types: Inflicts heavy physical damage blended with magic damage from gravity infusions. Does not inflict status ailments such as Bleed, Frost, or Scarlet Rot.

• Synergies & Buffs:
- Roar Skills: Direct, unique mechanical synergy with roar-type Ashes of War, unlocking his artillery volley and bonus damage.
- Aura & Area Buffs: Receives full benefits from aura and group buffs (such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, and Rallying Cry) as well as continuous regeneration or direct healing incantations.
- Tactical Role: Serves as a premier sniper, distraction anchor, and durable hybrid combatant capable of locking down targets from afar while holding his ground in close combat.

name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
description:
One of Seluvis's favorite puppets.
Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux.

Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill.

A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.
effect:
Summons the puppet spirit of Nepheli Loux.

• Upgrade Material: Ghost Glovewort (+1 to +10).
• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons a single puppet spirit. Nepheli wears the Champion Set (Champion Headband, Champion Pauldron, Champion Bracers, and Champion Gaiters) and dual-wields two Stormhawk Axes in a powerstanced configuration.
• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly aggressive close-quarters melee combatant. Nepheli relentlessly advances toward targets, executing rapid dual-axe combos, leaping dual attacks, and sweeping strikes. Her signature ability is the weapon skill Thunderstorm, in which she spins her dual axes to summon an electrified whirlwind around herself, infusing both weapons with lightning before unleashing follow-up sweeping slashes and downward strikes.
• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Deals substantial Physical and Lightning damage. While she does not inflict passive status buildups like Bleed or Frostbite, the rapid multi-hit strikes of her dual axes combined with the wide AoE whirlwinds of Thunderstorm deal high stance damage and poise damage, capable of consistently staggering humanoid foes and breaking boss stances. Thunderstorm also provides effective crowd control against grouped enemies.
• Synergies & Buffs: As a singular named puppet, she can be enhanced with aura and body buffs (such as Golden Vow, Commander's Standard, or Uplifting Aromatic) and benefits from AoE healing spells (such as Blessing's Boon or Erdtree Heal). She serves as a powerful frontline offensive disruptor, drawing enemy aggression and creating frequent riposte opportunities for the summoner.

name: Soldjars Of Fortune Ashes
description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell.
Use to summon the spirits of three little living jars.
Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

These reckless spirits sacrifice themselves to vanquish their summoner's foes, and explode upon death. Though their bravery is admirable, their explosions can harm friend as well as foe, and they will also immediately explode on contact with fire.

"Tell the others—tell them how brightly a fire jar burns."
effect:
• Upgrade Material: Grave Glovewort (strengthened from +1 to +10). Upgrades enhance their total health pool and scale the damage of both their physical strikes and fiery detonations.

• Summon Composition & Equipment: Summons three diminutive Living Jars. They wield no weapons, shields, or armor, utilizing their earthenware ceramic bodies as blunt striking implements and volatile explosive payloads.

• Combat Behavior & Skills: Highly reckless and aggressive frontline skirmishers. The three jars waddle toward enemies, executing clumsy close-range body slams, belly flops, headbutts, and rolling tackles that deal Strike damage. Upon death or depletion of their health, each jar initiates a short countdown and detonates violently in an area-of-effect Fire explosion. Furthermore, exposure to any fire damage causes them to detonate instantly without delay. Notably, their explosions feature friendly fire and will damage and knock back the summoner if caught within the blast radius.

• Status Effects & Stance Damage: Inflicts no innate status ailments (no Bleed, Frostbite, Poison, or Scarlet Rot). Physical ramming attacks deal minor poise damage, but their self-sacrificial death explosions deliver substantial stance damage, heavy stagger, and knockdown force against humanoid enemies and mobs.

• Synergies & Buffs: Consumes 135 HP instead of FP, making them ideal for builds with minimal Mind investment. Their suicidal fire nature allows the summoner to remotely detonate them using Fire Pots, Fire Arrows, or ranged fire incantations/sorceries into packed groups of enemies. They benefit from aura damage buffs such as Golden Vow and Commander's Standard, though maintaining distance is vital to avoid friendly-fire detonation damage.
